verdict.rationale: Core tax workflows are API-accessible. The standalone Tax Calculations and Tax Transactions APIs cover calculation, recording and reversals, with parameters like shipping_cost, IP geolocation and taxability_reason, and registrations can be added via the Dashboard or the Tax Registrations API. An official CLI and MCP server also exist. However, the evidence never shows parity for several Dashboard features: reports and itemized exports, registration monitoring insights, Stripe-managed registration, and TaxJar filing. The OpenAPI probes also returned 404. Missing for 10: documented API equivalents for reports/exports, monitoring insights and Stripe-assisted registration/filing; an explicit API–UI parity statement; a discoverable OpenAPI spec.
